profile.name: BLU 激光功率/能量计
profile.description: Gentec-EO BLU 是一类用于连接激光探头并读取测量结果的激光功率/能量计接口，可测量激光功率或单次脉冲能量。设备支持 USB 或蓝牙通信，适用于激光实验、光学系统调试、功率监测和能量校准等场景。
profile.description_en: The Gentec-EO BLU is a laser power and energy meter interface used with compatible sensor heads to read laser power or single-shot pulse energy. It supports USB or Bluetooth communication and is used in laser experiments, optical system setup, power monitoring, and energy calibration.
